name: career
description: Evidence-first career support for direction, research, job discovery, materials, applications and campaigns, inbox and recruiter coordination, interviews, offers, operations, development, and data governance.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-first support across the career lifecycle.
interface.longDescription: Build a durable career context, choose direction, research roles and labor markets, discover and evaluate opportunities, produce traceable materials, assist with applications, coordinate recruiter conversations, prepare for interviews, compare offers, plan development, and learn from an event-sourced pipeline. Claims remain linked to evidence, live facts are dated, uncertainty stays visible, and external actions require a reviewed plan plus explicit authority at the final boundary.
capabilities: Dated labor-market, role, employer, and compensation research
Transparent fit, constraint, risk, and gap analysis
Evidence-backed resumes, profiles, portfolios, and case studies
Role-specific application tailoring and claim validation
Reviewed application campaigns with reserves and receipt reconciliation
Bounded career inbox triage and opportunity matching
Networking, recruiter communication, and scheduling drafts
Offer normalization, comparison, and negotiation planning
Event-sourced pipeline tracking and conversion learning
Deterministic daily operations briefs and ever-reached funnel metrics
Career-data inventory, retention, export, and deletion planning
Vetted source-adapter contracts with explicit effect classes
defaultPrompt: Help me decide the next concrete step in my career using only supported facts and visible assumptions.
Set up a private local career workspace, import my evidence, and show me what still needs confirmation.
Analyze this opportunity, tailor the requested materials, and stop before any external action.
